verzen.tekst: My son, if you come to serve the Lord,
verzen.html: My son, if you come to serve the Lord,

verzen.tekst: Set your heart aright, constantly endure,
verzen.html: Set your heart aright, constantly endure,

verzen.tekst: Cling to him, and don’t depart,
verzen.html: Cling to him, and don’t depart,

verzen.tekst: Accept whatever is brought upon you,
verzen.html: Accept whatever is brought upon you,

verzen.tekst: For gold is tried in the fire,
verzen.html: For gold is tried in the fire,

verzen.tekst: Put your trust in him, and he will help you.
verzen.html: Put your trust in him, and he will help you.

verzen.tekst: All you who fear the Lord, wait for his mercy.
verzen.html: All you who fear the Lord, wait for his mercy.

verzen.tekst: All you who fear the Lord, put your trust in him,
verzen.html: All you who fear the Lord, put your trust in him,

verzen.tekst: All you who fear the Lord, hope for good things,
verzen.html: All you who fear the Lord, hope for good things,

verzen.tekst: Look at the generations of old, and see:
verzen.html: Look at the generations of old, and see:

verzen.tekst: For the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.
verzen.html: For the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.

verzen.tekst: Woe to fearful hearts, to faint hands,
verzen.html: Woe to fearful hearts, to faint hands,

verzen.tekst: Woe to the faint heart! For it doesn’t believe.
verzen.html: Woe to the faint heart! For it doesn’t believe.

verzen.tekst: Woe to you who have lost your patience!
verzen.html: Woe to you who have lost your patience!

verzen.tekst: Those who fear the Lord will not disobey his words.
verzen.html: Those who fear the Lord will not disobey his words.

verzen.tekst: Those who fear the Lord will seek his good pleasure.
verzen.html: Those who fear the Lord will seek his good pleasure.

verzen.tekst: Those who fear the Lord will prepare their hearts,
verzen.html: Those who fear the Lord will prepare their hearts,

verzen.tekst: We will fall into the hands of the Lord,
verzen.html: We will fall into the hands of the Lord,
